description: List the readable text inside any file, given as base64, at most 2,000,000 bytes: runs of ASCII and UTF-16LE characters (UTF-8 on request) at least min_length long, with byte offsets. Labels each string by shape as a URL, email, IP address, file path, key or token, or other, and counts every kind across the whole file; the list can be narrowed by kind or text and holds up to 2,000 strings in file order. Pure standard library, no network or model.

contains.description: Only list strings containing this text (any case).

encodings.description: Which text to look for: ascii, utf-16le and utf-8. Default ascii and utf-16le; utf-8 also reads accented and other non-English letters, and finds more false text in random bytes.

file.description: Required. Any file, as base64 or a base64 data URL; at most 2,000,000 bytes once decoded.

filename.description: Optional file name, used only in the result text.

kinds.description: Only list strings of these kinds (url, email, ip, path, key, other). Counts always cover all.

limit.description: Most strings to list, in file order. Default and maximum 2,000.

min_length.description: Shortest run of characters to keep, 3 to 32. Default 4.

name: extract_strings
title: Strings Extractor
